discoverySentence.text: Weapons deal 35% less direct damage, but enemies they kill explode and can trigger diminishing chain reactions.

trigger.condition: an enemy defeated by weapon damage explodes after a short readable delay; explosions can chain through further generations

acquisition.method: found in a relic cache through map exploration
acquisition.cacheOpening: automatic on mech contact; freezes the complete gameplay simulation
acquisition.resolution: immediate install-or-sell; no relic inventory or deferred decision

rarityAndWeighting.selectionModel: three distinct relics drawn without replacement from the currently unlocked pool and assigned to the three caches during generation

stackingAndExclusivity.modifierOrder: Relic-specific multipliers apply after the additive percentage modifiers supplied by mech traits, utilities, and PowerUps unless the relic explicitly replaces targeting or cadence.

behaviorRegistration.hook: direct-damage reduction and generational death explosion
behaviorRegistration.registrationModel: Relics are cross-cutting policies registered by stable relic ID. They modify well-defined hook points rather than scattering ID checks through every weapon.
behaviorRegistration.perWeaponCompatibilityManifest: produced from tests; states fully affected, partially affected with disclosed reason, or invalid. The initial design expects no invalid pairing.

rules.text: All direct and persistent damage attributed to equipped weapons is multiplied by 0.65.
An enemy defeated by weapon damage explodes after a short readable delay. Explosion strength and Area scale from that enemy's maximum Hull, subject to a cap for elites and bosses.
A fission explosion can defeat other enemies and create further explosions. Each generation deals less damage and has smaller Area than the generation that caused it until the chain ends.

Explosions are attributed to the relic for statistics but count as weapon-caused defeats for compatible run rules. They cannot damage the player, mining points, caches, pickups, or destructible rocks.
The relic is intentionally powerful against dense ordinary hordes and comparatively poor against an isolated boss without nearby chain fuel.
Exact explosion scaling, generational decay, delay, and boss cap remain numerical tuning.

crossDocumentRules.rule: Fission explosions may recurse only through their explicit generation counter and decay; they never affect rocks or the player.
